subject: social_studies
concept: Identifying the legitimate civic channels available to address the chosen issue (local government, organizations, petitions, direct action)
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to Grade 7's civic-participation transition unit — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches their chosen issue to a real, legitimate channel through which it could realistically be addressed
exercise.abstract: Student identifies a specific, legitimate civic channel appropriate for their chosen issue

misconception_flags: proposes a channel with no realistic connection to how the issue could actually be addressed

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
